reviews.text: The class is not that bad, but there is no rubric for any assignment, so you never know what you're getting graded on. They expect super detailed and in-depth discussions, same with the midterm and final. The midterm is 120 minutes timed, and the final is 180. There was a big AI incident where apparently most of the class cheated on the midterm, so if you wanna use sources, have another device ready or just take weekly notes on paper. Overall pretty good class.
